p = 'main.py'

end = s.index("# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Compilation of one request")
new = '''    class_key = class_of.__getitem__
    while True:
        queue = deque(range(len(blocks)))
        queued = set(queue)
        pop_left = queue.popleft
        push = queue.append
        while queue:
            bid = pop_left()
            queued.discard(bid)
            block = blocks[bid]
            if not block:
                continue
            # A snapshot keeps the splitter a union of current classes even
            # when the block itself is split while being processed.
            splitter = block.copy()
            for a in range(alphabet):
                if splitter.isdisjoint(active[a]):
                    continue
                sources = rev[a]
                movers = set(chain.from_iterable(map(sources.__getitem__,
                                                     splitter)))
                if not movers:
                    continue
                for cls in set(map(class_key, movers)):
                    target = blocks[cls]
                    moved = target & movers
                    if not moved or len(moved) == len(target):
                        continue
                    target -= moved
                    fresh = len(blocks)
                    blocks.append(moved)
                    for s in moved:
                        class_of[s] = fresh
                    if cls in queued:
                        queued.add(fresh)
                        push(fresh)
                    elif len(moved) <= len(target):
                        queued.add(fresh)
                        push(fresh)
                    else:
                        queued.add(cls)
                        push(cls)
        # Stability check: the partition must now be a congruence.
        representative = {}
        stable = True
        for s in range(n):
            cls = class_of[s]
            signature = tuple(map(class_key, trans[s]))
            known = representative.get(cls)
            if known is None:
                representative[cls] = signature
            elif known != signature:
                stable = False
                break
        if stable:
            return class_of, distance


'''
